manifest.title: SEO Playground
manifest.tagline: Self-hosted SEO dashboard powered by DataForSEO
manifest.description:
SEO Playground is a self-hosted dashboard on top of the [DataForSEO](https://dataforseo.com) API. You bring your own DataForSEO account and pay DataForSEO directly for what you use; nothing is sent anywhere else.

* **Rank Tracker** with daily history and the top 10 results of every check
* **Local Finder / Geo-grid** rank maps with scheduled monitors and PDF reports
* **Site Audit**, **Google Reviews** analysis and **web mentions**
* **AI Visibility** and **Prompt Tracker**: see whether ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity mention your brand
* **White-label PDF reports** with your own logo and colours
* Multiple projects, each with its own database, and a spending overview
manifest.changelog: * Initial Cloudron package of SEO Playground 0.4.0
manifest.postInstallMessage:
SEO Playground is installed. Only Cloudron users can open it: Cloudron's login screen sits in front of the app.

1. Open the app and go to **Settings** to enter your DataForSEO login and password (or API key). They are stored in the app's database, which is part of the Cloudron backups.
2. Everything you run is billed by DataForSEO, so grant access to people you trust with that credit.

Your data lives in `/app/data` (one SQLite file per project). The scheduled Geo-grid and Prompt Tracker checks run inside the app, so there is nothing else to configure.

manifest.changelog:
[0.6.0]
* Update to SEO Playground 0.6.0
* New: Broken Backlinks, Review Velocity (review pace vs. local competitors), sidebar favorites, Geo-grid distance unit (km/miles) and pin style settings
* Fix: Rank Tracker could bill the same keyword twice; DataForSEO account errors (e.g. insufficient balance) no longer look like empty results; Referring Domains "Invalid Field" error
* Security: paid API endpoints only answer POST, CSV exports are formula-safe, Next.js and jsPDF security updates
* Includes 0.5.0: Prompt Tracker, white-label PDF reports, Geo-grid business search, Rank Tracker top 10 and AI Overview citations

[0.4.1]
* Fix maps blocked by OpenStreetMap ("app is not following the OSM tile usage policy"): tiles and address search now send a Referer even behind the Cloudron proxy

[0.4.0]
* Initial Cloudron package of SEO Playground 0.4.0
